votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 16 of 2023, adopting the Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zone Tax Increment Reimbursement Program Policy.
votes.description: Adopts a policy establishing a Tax Increment Reimbursement Program for Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zones (HTRZs), allowing a portion of property tax generated by qualifying mixed-use, affordable housing developments near public transit to be returned to developers over a fixed period.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 17 of 2023, amending the bylaws to modify the chairperson's term.
votes.description: Amends the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City bylaws to modify the eligibility and term rules for the Chairperson position, including provisions related to consecutive terms.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 18 of 2023, Loan to Rocky Ventures, Inc. for The Front Climbing Club.
votes.description: Approves a $2,000,000 loan with a three-year term to Rocky Ventures, Inc. to support expansion and remodeling of The Front climbing gym at 1470 South 400 West in the State Street Project Area.
